title: Six Health Organizations to Debut Connected Oral
html:
By News Staff

November 6, 2026

Share

Oral Genome, Health and Wellness Intelligence (HWI), Teledentistry.com, Vista Apex Solutions, Evena Health and Orasom Health, with support from the venture capital firm Revere Partners, will operate the experience at HLTH 2026 in Booth 2860 in the Oral-Systemic Pavilion, November 15 to 18 in Las Vegas. According to the partners, the demonstration addresses a handoff that too often gets dropped: a dental finding rarely reaches a medical chart, and a recommendation rarely becomes an appointment.

Visitors to the booth will provide a saliva sample for a two-minute test, review their results with a licensed dentist, choose a next step, and leave with their plan on their phone, with the journey continuing after the event ends. Oral Genome's saliva screening reads seven biomarkers the company associates with caries and periodontal risk, with results available in about 15 minutes. A dentist licensed through Teledentistry.com then goes over each result with the patient, taking vital signs, risk assessments, and intraoral images into account before suggesting individualized next steps. From there, the choice of next step belongs to the individual. According to the partners, the options range from PerioSciences oral-care products and the prescription periodontal care of Perio Protect, both offered through Vista Apex Solutions, to Evena's nightly oral probiotic and the sleep apnea care pathway from Orasom Health. When in-person care is needed, the partners say SmartyPlan offers dental savings. With consent, HWI will check in at Day 7 and Day 30, and a repeat screening at Day 90 is intended to show what changed.

"Your spit has a story," said Tina Saw, DDS, founder and CEO of Oral Genome. "At HLTH, people will see the whole story, not just the first chapter."

"Dentistry is no longer confined to the four walls of a practice. It is becoming a continuous, patient-centered journey," said Vilas Sastry, DMD, CEO of Teledentistry.com.

"Finding a concern is only the beginning. What patients do between visits matters just as much," said Eric Shirley, CEO of Vista Apex Solutions.

"Insight without action doesn't change outcomes," added Jeff Barber, founder of Evena Health. "Personalized recommendations can connect oral health to whole-body care through a simple daily step."

"Dentists are often the first to spot airway issues, but the referral for sleep testing is where most patients drop off," said Andrew Lee, RDH, founder and CEO of Orasom Health. "We've built the bridge from home testing to oral appliance therapy."

"Most health tools stop at the result. We follow what happens next," said Neil Arabe, founder and CEO of Health and Wellness Intelligence (HWI). "What was recommended, what each person chose and what changed: that is the story healthcare rarely gets to see."

"HLTH is the quintessential oral and systemic health event, bringing together perspectives from dentistry and medicine," said Jeremy Krell, founder and managing partner of Revere Partners. "The outcome is innovation that drives cutting-edge technology advancements across healthcare."

According to the companies, Oral Genome is a health and wellness biotechnology company whose rapid, saliva-based testing is intended to help people understand how oral health connects to whole-body wellness. HWI describes its platform as tying together health signals, clinical recommendations, patient decisions, and follow-through within a single longitudinal record, giving organizations a view of whether recommended care actually takes place and how a patient's status changes over time. Teledentistry.com provides 24/7 emergency and preventive dental consultations across all 50 states, Puerto Rico, and Guam. Vista Apex Solutions operates a healthcare platform oriented toward clinicians and oversees a portfolio of dental brands that includes Vista Apex, Perio Protect, and PerioSciences. Evena Health makes Evena Nightly Oral Probiotic, a dissolvable tablet used after brushing that the company says supports a balanced oral microbiome and healthy gums. Orasom Health provides dentists a medical pathway to treat sleep apnea from the dental chair, from home sleep testing through claims. Revere Partners, the investor backing the initiative, is a venture firm with a worldwide scope that targets companies working where oral health, healthcare, and technology converge.

HLTH attendees can reserve a private VIP experience at oralgenome.com/hlth or visit Booth 2860 in the Oral-Systemic Pavilion.
